description: Create a dedicated Settings page with dark mode toggle (persisted via localStorage). Add dark mode CSS to all page stylesheets. Add a /Settings route to IndexController. Replace the broken inline settings dropdowns in Applications.html, Companies.html, and Timeline.html with a nav link to /Settings. Add a dark mode init script (darkmode.js) to all main templates. Fix the broken nav link in index.html (shows 'Resources' text but links to /Login). This feature depends on FEAT-001 only in that it also touches Applications.html — read the FEAT-001 state of that file before editing.
steps: Add GET /Settings mapping to IndexController.java at /home/simon/Downloads/JOB-TRRACKER-main/src/main/java/com/job_tracker/job/tracker/IndexController.java: add @GetMapping('/Settings') public String showSettings() { return 'Settings'; }

Create darkmode.js at /home/simon/Downloads/JOB-TRRACKER-main/src/main/resources/static/js/darkmode.js. Content: (function(){ if(localStorage.getItem('darkMode')==='true'){ document.documentElement.classList.add('dark-mode'); } })(); — use documentElement (html tag) not body so it applies before CSS paint.

Create settings.css at /home/simon/Downloads/JOB-TRRACKER-main/src/main/resources/static/css/settings.css. Full polished CSS matching the app design (primary #0D80F2, font Inter, bg #F0F2F5, border-radius 8px). Include: header/nav styles matching application.css patterns, .settings-main wrapper (max-width 960px, margin 0 auto, padding 40px 20px), .settings-section (white card, border 1px solid #E6E8EB, border-radius 8px, padding 24px, margin-bottom 16px), .settings-row (display flex, justify-content space-between, align-items center), section headings in Inter bold 18px color #121417. Also include body.dark-mode overrides: background #1a1a2e, color #e0e0e0, card bg #16213e, border #2a2a4e. Include the toggle switch CSS (same .switch/.slider pattern from Login.css).

Create Settings.html at /home/simon/Downloads/JOB-TRRACKER-main/src/main/resources/templates/Settings.html. Full Thymeleaf template with: <head> linking settings.css and darkmode.js. Header+nav identical to Applications.html structure (logo + Dashboard/Applications/Settings nav links, profile image). Main content: <main class='settings-main'>, heading 'Settings', four sections: (1) Appearance with dark mode toggle switch (id='darkMode', class='switch' pattern), (2) Language select (id='language', options English/Spanish), (3) Notifications checkbox (id='emailNotif'), (4) Privacy select (id='profileVisibility', options Public/Private). Save Settings button (id='saveSettings', styled blue). Inline <script> for settings logic: on DOMContentLoaded, load saved values from localStorage into the form controls; darkMode toggle applies/removes 'dark-mode' class on document.documentElement and saves to localStorage; Save button saves all values to localStorage and shows a toast (call window.showToast if available, otherwise use alert). Include <script th:src='@{/js/darkmode.js}'> in <head> and <script th:src='@{/js/notifications.js}'> before </body> (notifications.js will be created in FEAT-004 — it is safe to reference it here, the browser will just get a 404 until FEAT-004 runs, which is acceptable).
